Noted — assigning to Hannah for legal redline. My initial triage below (will follow with tracked changes):

Priority items to address first:
1) Data residency/residency exhibit: We can offer an EU processing exhibit for the pilot. Need Product to confirm whether we can isolate EU-only processing or provide contractual commitment with appropriate SOC2 and transfer safeguards.
2) Indemnity/IP carveouts: Standard Redwood stance is to accept indemnity for third-party IP claims limited to direct damages and with mutual indemnities. We should push back on unlimited third-party IP indemnity.
3) Change-of-control termination: We normally allow termination for change-of-control with a 60-day notice and post-closing obligations; immediate payment/acceleration is unusual.
4) Liability cap: propose 3x fees for 12 months or $5M whichever is lower (need finance input).
5) Audit and security: confirm SOC2 report availability and whether customer requests ongoing attestations.

Timeline: Hannah to produce a marked-up MSA + comment summary by 2026-10-13 EOD. If anything looks like a high commercial impact (discount, extended liability), I'll coordinate with Marissa for sales approval.

-Kimberly
Head of Contracts Operations

I've completed a first-pass review and added tracked changes to the attached draft. High-level summary for Sales:

- Data residency: We can accommodate an EU-only processing exhibit. Product confirmed we can route pilot data to EU processing nodes; we'll include Exhibit D (EU Data Processing Addendum). No pricing delta for pilot; discuss for production.
- Indemnity/IP: We will accept mutual IP indemnities with a defense/indemnify structure but will NOT accept unlimited third-party IP indemnity without carveouts (prioritized edits in section 9).
- Change-of-control termination: Edit to require 60-day notice and allow cure; no immediate acceleration of payments.
- Liability cap: Recommend standard cap = the greater of (12 months fees actually paid under the Order Form) or $1M floor, with an absolute cap of $5M for enterprise. If Sales needs a higher cap for the deal, escalate for credit approval.
- Security evidence: Provide current SOC2 Type II and ISO attestation links; offer an on-site audit with NDA for large customers (cost recovery).

Questions for Sales/Customer:
1) Confirm expected ARR or estimated 12-month fees for liability cap modeling.
2) Confirm whether Finedge expects all EU customer data to be segmented for the pilot (technical detail).

I'll attach the marked document (tracked changes) and a short comment memo. Plan to send our redline and summary to Liam once we get the ARR estimate and confirmation on EU segmentation.

-Hannah
Senior Counsel, Contracts
